blurb: For the last years Tijuana has made his mark in the world craft beer scene with his big variety of styles in beers like IPAs, stouts, sours, porters, Lagers, many of them with a crazy Tijuana twist. The craft-beer scene in the city has given Tijuana a whole new personality. This Tijuana tour will take you to visit 6 of the most important local taprooms and do some beer tastings. Take a tour from San Diego to Tijuana and be amazed by the growing craft beer scene. Take a walk thru Tijuana downtown to discover cultural alleys, mystic animal like the Zonkey, hidden tap rooms in abandoned churches or nightclubs and many souvenir stores with a lot of Mexican traditional crafts. Tijuana has the featured that the most important breweries are in the Downton and all of them have their own personality and ambiance. If you are a big craft beer fan this tour it the right one for you, the Tijuana craft beer scene it's something you don’t want to miss. What goes well with craft beer? Well, easy... Tacos. So, we will have some break time in the tacos to continue our travois. Going from one brewery to another and walking thru zonkeys and cultural alley´s it’s an almost surreal experience, where you will see the big mix of cultures that gives Tijuana its personality. At all time you will be accompanied with an experienced guide that will attend any needs you could have along the way.
